media:group.media:description:
2026 Maison Margiela × Gentle Monster
Gentle Monster and Maison Margiela present an Alex Prager short film for their fourth collaboration campaign. Through the lens of artist Alex Prager, the campaign follows a protagonist’s journey through unexpected moments within the everyday, exploring the beauty of the unfinished.
Directed by Alex Prager Music “Mentally Gone” by SCAM
Launching on October 29th US, Canada: Oct 29th 11AM (EST) Korea, China, Japan, Australia: Oct 29th 11AM (KST) Europe, United Kingdom, Middle East and Other Regions: Oct 29th 11AM (GMT)

media:group.media:description:
The PRADA GENTLE MONSTER campaign, featuring Prada Ambassador Kentaro Sakaguchi, blurs the lines between reality and imagination. Revolving around the concept of a book, five fictional forces unfold at one’s fingertips: earth, water, fire, air, and love. Coming soon to Japan, South Korea, China Mainland, and Hong Kong SAR, for a limited time. Launch starting in Japan on July 6 offline and July 7 online.
